Stack: OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Llama, n8n, Make, ElevenLabs, Twilio, PostgreSQL. Integrations: HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Airtable, Notion, WhatsApp Business API, Slack via REST & GraphQL.
